acceptanceCriteria: Parity/documentation-owned active Work Items require regular non-symlink docs/work-items/<WI>.md, <WI>.ja.md, and <WI>.zh-CN.md before verification/archive/close.
Current archived parity Work Items with a missing, malformed, or symlinked tri-language Work Item document fail the same static gate.
Current-cycle parity debts discovered by the new gate are repaired with truthful tri-language projections without rewriting generated .ai history.
Ordinary non-parity code Work Items remain active_non_parity and do not acquire a documentation requirement.
Regression tests cover missing, partial, symlinked, and valid tri-language projections with deterministic finding codes.
The English, Japanese, and Chinese governance documentation state the dynamic policy and object/adopter inheritance boundary.
goal: Make the CI governance gate fail closed before pre-close lifecycle progression when a parity-owned Work Item is missing or symlinked in any of its English, Japanese, or Simplified Chinese docs; repair current-cycle omissions exposed by the gate; add deterministic regression coverage and document the dynamic policy.
intent: Prevent parity/documentation Work Items from reaching verification or closure without the required tri-language Work Item document projections, while preserving a lightweight path for ordinary code Work Items.
outOfScope: ordinary non-parity Work Item documentation requirements
